items.title: 'Assassination plot' impeachment trial involving Duterte dynasty begins in Manila
items.description: A highly consequential impeachment trial against Philippines Vice-President Sara Duterte could spell the end for her political career and shape the nation's 2028 election.

items.title: 'Terrifying' roadside assistance ordeal sparks national change
items.description: A woman's campaign for change after her own frightening experience being broken down outside Canberra will see NRMA roadside assistance contractors required to provide a code to customers to verify their identity.

items.title: England's Azteca thriller a stunning deliverance from ghosts of the past
items.description: England teams of old would have buckled under the pressure put upon them by Mexico and their 80,000-strong band of supporters at the Azteca. But this England team turned a nightmare into a dreamland, at a venue haunted by so many ghosts of the past.

items.title: Socceroos winger says One Nation monoculture debate 'bulls***'
items.description: The Socceroos star says anyone "trying to divide" the community is "probably not Australian themselves".

items.title: Australia 'very concerned' by Chinese ballistic missile test in Pacific
items.description: China has test-fired a long-range missile with a dummy warhead in the Pacific Ocean. The ABC has been told the Chinese government informed governments in the region about the test.

items.title: 'Like a small iceberg': Rare whale calf spotted swimming off east coast
items.description: The calf, thought to be one of only a dozen in the Southern Hemisphere, has been spotted swimming alongside its mother.

items.title: Concerns about cricket pitches on ovals after Melbourne football tragedy
items.description: Nathan Fitzgerald's club has asked authorities to look at the way hard cricket pitches are covered on multi-use ovals as the 27-year-old continues to receive end-of-life care.

items.title: NSW government announces review into boy's death amid cannibalism probe
items.description: Cannibalism will form part of an investigation into the death of a four-year-old boy on the NSW Central Coast, with an independent review to take place by the Department of Communities and Justice.

items.title: Australia enters new alliance with Fiji and more Pacific nations could join
items.description: Australia and Fiji strike a new defence alliance in a major development that could reshape the Pacific's strategic landscape.

items.title: The world is getting pure Trump and the US presidency may never be the same
items.description: Donald Trump is undertaking regime change, not just in Venezuela, but on US soil and it is unlikely the presidency will ever be the same.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
